author: Ben Janca
description:
Yasmine is a mixup monster.

Yasmine excels in the mid and close range, rushing down her opponents with multi hitting attacks and tricky air mobility. And once Yasmine has the advantage, she can further lockdown her foe with an offensive boomerang special, providing an opportunity for a mixup. Here's gameplay of this mixup monster with the CPU set to level 7 mirror matches.
title: Street Fighter 6 Yasmine High Level Gameplay (CPU Level 7)

author: Erick Tay
description:
Learn how Blade turns every fight into a hunt. From Heartstopper pins and instant gap-closers to Muramasa’s red-hot power, discover the tools, pressure, and precision that make him a deadly threat.

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!
title: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls Official Blade Character Gameplay Guide

author: Heidi Kemps
description:
Online gambling has been in the news a fair bit recently, with the ease of getting into online sportsbook betting becoming a hotly contested issue in the United States and popular prediction markets being subjected to increased controversy and government scrutiny. It's hardly limited to the United States, however, as illicit online gambling has wide appeal across much of Asia, despite local laws forbidding much of it.

South Korea in particular has seen an uptick in online gambling, particularly among youth
title: Country Turns To Gaming Legend To Counterplay Online Gambling Epidemic

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Season 5 arrives to Black Ops 7 on July 23, and Activision has revealed the season is also being paired with a new multiplayer matchmaking system inspired by the older Call of Duty games. Here we highlight all the modes affected and what you need to know before Season 5 launches.

Call of Duty's matchmaking has long been a hot topic of the community, and Black Ops 7 was the first title in years to receive a matchmaking system that didn't heavily favor a skill-based formula. The game currently features "Open" playlists, which Activision previously described as only including "minimal skill consideration," or, in essence, little or no SBMM. This was presumed to be closer to the matchmaking system of the older Call of Duty games.

Now, Call of Duty is changing matchmaking again. The publisher describes this new system as being "inspired" by the classic matchmaking of past games. This new
title: Call Of Duty Is Introducing A New “Classic” Matchmaking System In Season 5

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
A lot of the mainstream buzz around Magic: The Gathering in recent months has revolved around its Universes Beyond initiative, which has introduced outside IP into the decades-old card game. Final Fantasy, Avatar: The Last Airbender, and most recently Marvel Super Heroes have released full expansions, with The Hobbit and Star Trek set to arrive later this year. 

However, the reason those outside IP were able to join Magic was because of the strong universe of characters and locations the game has built in those 30-plus years. At MagicCon Amsterdam, the Preview Panel focused on Magic's established multiverse, as the hour-long panel revealed all three in-universe sets coming to Magic in 2027, with the Universes Beyond announcements saved for another day.
title: Magic: The Gathering’s Multiverse Is Gearing Up For Its Next Big Story In 2027

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Gaming legend Shigeru Miyamoto, the creator of Mario and The Legend of Zelda, has spoken up to defend remakes. A lot of people embrace and enjoy remakes, while others say developers should instead spend more time and resources on entirely new games.

Miyamoto, for his part, said remakes are good, actually, because a lot of people might have missed out on a game when it was originally released. Beyond that, commercial success of a remake can lead to additional resources that a company can use to put into new projects, Miyamoto said.

“Some people might say there are a lot of remakes, but after five years, a lot of people have outgrown games and stop playing them. Young people today don’t have the opportunity to play games from 10 years ago, so remaking them to be more playable and releasing them again is a good way to meet the demand," he told
title: Nintendo’s Shigeru Miyamoto Defends Remakes Ahead Of Ocarina Of Time Switch 2 Remake

author: Cameron Koch
description:
BlizzCon 2026 is shaping up to be a major moment for the house World of Warcraft built, but even if you won't be in attendance, Blizzard will still let you buy all kinds of cosmetics to celebrate the occasion.

Though BlizzCon this year isn't until September 12, players can buy digital BlizzCon bundles for all of Blizzard's major live-service games right now. Those lucky enough to have a BlizzCon ticket will get every bundle for free. Each bundle individually costs $25 or $30, but snagging the BlizzCon Ultimate Collection bundle, which includes every individual bundle plus a few extras for each game, is $50.

If you sink a significant amount of time into more than one Blizzard game and are keen on
title: If You Aren’t Going To BlizzCon 2026, You Can Still Spend Money Like You Are

author: Levi Winslow
description:
With Halo: Campaign Evolved's early access period set to kick off on July 23, you may be wondering just how to enable cross-platform play so you and your fellow Spartans can kick grunt butt across PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. Well, the process is actually super simple, so let us break it down for you right here.

As outlined in a July 22 blog on the Halo Waypoint site, playing this Halo remake with your friends is easy. All you have to do is know their Gamertag or Username, search for and add it to your Xbox friends list--either on the Xbox site, from the Xbox Game Bar, or in the Xbox mobile app--then add them to your party from the "Cross-Platform Friends" list of the "Play Co-op" menu when they're online.

And j
title: Here’s How To Play Halo: Campaign Evolved With Your Friends Across Xbox, PlayStation, And PC

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Sony's decision to kill physical PlayStation games in January 2028 has, understandably, gotten under the skin of just about everyone. And while Disgea's creator says the company should just stop making consoles altogether if there won't be any more physical games, an analyst is sounding the alarm on how Sony's decision could be the death knell for brick-and-mortar gaming stores in the future.

Michael Pachter, managing director of strategic planning at the LA-based financial services firm Wedbush Securities, spoke to CNBC on July 21 about the possible ramific
title: Analyst Says Sony Killing Physical PS5 Games “Dooms” Brick-And-Mortar Stores

author: Callum Self
description:
If there’s one thing I find a bit rough about the Steam Machine, it’s the price. While it’s a far more accessible way to get a PC gaming experience without the hassle of building a computer yourself, the current price of gaming hardware makes it a hard purchase to recommend. However, if you told me you got the 2TB model for just $1, I’d probably cry with excitement for you, with just a dash of disappointment that it wasn’t me.

Fortunately, the idea of me crying isn’t so ridiculous. With Fanatical’s new Mystery Vault Bundle, anyone - you or I included - could win the coveted Steam Machine, along with the new Steam Controller. That package is worth $1,400, and winning it for just $1 would earn you bragging rights for years to come.

You’re not paying solely for a chance to
title: Here’s Your Chance To Score A 2TB Steam Machine And Controller For Just $1

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Growing up in the '90s and early aughts, Backyard Baseball was the game of my generation. What was once found in cereal boxes as a free pack-in became a brand that decorated millennial childhoods across many sequels and different sports. I was so excited when it was announced that someone had gotten the gears turning on bringing the beloved but, until recently, hard-to-find series back to modern platforms. The revival has included re-listings of several of the original games, plus a brand-new entry for Backyard Baseball. It's that one that maybe had the most riding on it, and for the most part, it delivers.

Let's start with what works. Backyard Baseball, not to be confused with
title: The Backyard Baseball Revival Is Solid In Every Way But One

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
Backwards compatibility is finally coming to PC, with Xbox announcing the initiative with four original Xbox classics now available to download on your desktop or handheld PC of choice.

Starting today, you'll be able to download and play Blinx: The Time Sweeper, Fuzion Frenzy, Conker: Live and Reloaded, and Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge on PC. If you own these games already, or are subscribed to Xbox Game Pass, you'll automatically see them in your library via the Xbox app, as well as the option to purchase them if you don't. Xbox says that this is just the start of its backwards-compatibility efforts on PC, with the program still in an early-release phase.

The releases come with a variety of enhancements, including 4x resolution scaling, customizable graphics modes, fullscreen and windowed
title: Xbox Brings Backwards Compatibility To PC, Starting With Four Classics

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Hasbro and Nintendo are teaming up for The Legend of Zelda toys, and the first have now been revealed as part of the start of San Diego Comic-Con.

These include Zelda, Link, and Ganondorf figures, based on their designs from The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom. The Zelda and Link figures are six-inch scale figures with 20+ points of articulation.
title: Hasbro’s The Legend Of Zelda Figures Have Been Revealed, And They Look Pretty Great

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Sony's decision to stop producing PlayStation discs in 2028 has been a lightning rod for discussion across the globe, and Disgaea series creator Sohei Niikawa has weighed in, saying that the company might as well stop making PlayStation hardware as well.

Speaking to Noisy Pixel at Anime Expo 2026, Niikawa explained why he thinks physical editions of games are still so important, as he believes that they still create a connection between fans and developers. Not only that, but those games can become a sentimental keepsake for those who collect them, adding a personal layer of value, the former president of Nippon Ichi Software added.
title: Disgaea Creator Says Sony May As Well Scrap PlayStation Consoles If It’s Killing Game Discs

author: Levi Winslow
description:
The internet's hearts have been stolen by yet another mammal, but instead of a small baby hippo named Moo Deng, it's a short-spined raccoon dubbed "Jimothy."

About a week ago, 33-year-old marketing specialist Kiana Hall posted an Instagram Reel of a creature that looks straight out of The Lord of the Rings--like Gollum's cousin or something. This creature, though odd-looking, was a raccoon with a round, stocky body. It's giving furry ham with legs, and the internet lost its collective mind.

title: Viral Raccoon “Jimothy” Gets His Own Browser Video Game, And The Internet Is Smitten

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Circana, formerly NPD, has released its latest monthly sales report for the US video game industry, and one key takeaway was that Xbox was the only console platform to grow in sales during the month.

Xbox Series X|S unit sales grew by 86% compared to June 2025, and June 2026 was the best month so far in 2026 for Xbox Series X|S sales, Circana said.

In June 2025, Xbox Series X|S sales were negatively impacted by the price increase that was put into effect in May 2025, Circana's Mat Piscatella added.

The Switch 2, meanwhile, saw its
title: Xbox Sales “More Than Doubled” In June 2026 In The US, While PS5 And Switch 2 Dropped

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Amazon MGM Studios has officially greenlit production on a new RoboCop TV series. Based on the classic 1987 movie directed by Paul Verhoeven, the series has already recruited Peter Ocko (Lodge 49) as its showrunner, while The Conjuring's James Wan will serve as one of its producers.

"I've been a massive fan of RoboCop forever, so getting to help bring this world to television is a dream," Wan said in a press statement (via Deadline). "What Paul Verhoeven created in 1987 was decades ahead of its time, and its questions about technology, identity, and who corporations really serve have only grown more urgent. With Peter's distinctive vision and bold approach to storytelling, and alongside Ed Neumeier, co-creator and our partners at Amazon MGM Studios, we're working to hon
title: I Wanted RoboCop: Rogue City 2 And All I Got Was This TV Series Announcement

author: Steve Watts
description:
The classic Nickelodeon cartoon Avatar: The Last Airbender was hailed as groundbreaking at the time of release and has inspired a loyal following, and its sequel series The Legend of Korra was a well-received maturation of the property. However, there have also been many lows--an awful movie adaptation, a divisive live-action Netflix series, and innumerable bad video games. This week, things are finally looking up. The movie Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender appears to be the Aang Gang reunion fans have been waiting for. And it's with that renewed vigor that we're getting Avatar Legends, which may be the first great Avatar game--with some major caveats.

To start, let me get this out of the way: I am not a fighting game expert. I came up during the era of Street Fighter 2 and Mortal Kombat and like every child of that generation, I threw down in
title: Avatar Legends Is A Real Treat For Fans, If You Can Overlook The Rough Edges

description: Parts of the fighting game seem strangely unfinished, but it gets a lot right about the show's look and spirit.
title: Avatar Legends Is A Real Treat For Fans, If You Can Overlook The Rough Edges

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
EA Sports has announced the cover star for FC 27's Ultimate Edition, and it's none other than superstar Kylian Mbappe. His national team, France, may have lost to Spain in the World Cup semifinals this year, but Mbappe scored a tournament-best 10 goals, earning himself the Golden Boot award.

Mbappe was also on the cover of FIFA 23 in 2022; that was when EA and FIFA were still in business together prior to the name change to FC.

EA Sports will share more details on FC 27 on July 27, so be sure to check back soon for more.

Mbappe, 27, said in a statement that it is a "very special moment" and an "honor" to continue partnering with EA for its professional footb
title: FC 27 Cover Star Announced, And It’s An Obvious Choice
